parameters.content:
## Google News Keyword & Full-Text Article Scraper

**Actor:** [Google News Keyword & Full-Text Article Scraper](https://apify.com/nimbryxo-studio/google-news-keyword-and-full-text-article-scraper)

**Docs:** https://github.com/bolvein-firex/scraping-n8n-workflows/blob/main/docs/google-news-keyword-and-full-text-article-scraper.md

### Setup
1. Create an Apify account and copy an API token.
2. In n8n, create a **Query Auth** credential:
   - Name: `Apify API Token`
   - Query parameter name: `token`
   - Value: your Apify token
3. Open **Run Apify Actor** and select that credential.
4. Click **Execute workflow**. The rows appear in **Rows ready**.
5. Optional: enable **Google Sheets** and set your document and sheet.

### Notes
- This calls the public Actor endpoint. No API token is stored in this file.
- `run-sync-get-dataset-items` waits up to 300 seconds. For large runs, switch to the async run + dataset endpoint.
- Public data only. Respect the target site's terms and local law.

### Input fields
- `mode` (string, required)
- `queries` (array)
- `topics` (array)
- `newsUrls` (array)
- `rssUrls` (array)
- `articleUrls` (array)
- `language` (string)
- `country` (string)
- `dateRange` (string)
- `startDate` (string)
- `endDate` (string)
- `maxResultsPerQuery` (integer)

### Output fields
- `title` (Title)
- `source` (Source)
- `domain` (Domain)
- `publishedAt` (Published)
- `url` (URL)
- `fullTextStatus` (Status)

description: Google News keyword scraper: runs the Google News Keyword & Full-Text Article Scraper Apify Actor, returns title, source, domain, publishedAt, url and more, then normalizes and dedupes the rows before an optional Google Sheets append.
